hebrewText: אִ֭יּוֹב לֹא בְ/דַ֣עַת יְדַבֵּ֑ר וּ֝/דְבָרָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א בְ/הַשְׂכֵּֽיל

tokens.bdb: Ijob, the patriarch famous for his patience
not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles

tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.explanation: davar — falar, dizer, declarar (forma verbal de davar)
